Validate the R environment, confirm all required packages are installed, and create the project folder structure before starting any analysis.

## 1. Validate R Environment

```{r}
#| label: validate_r_environment


cat("R version:", R.version$major, ".", R.version$minor, "\n")
cat("R home:", R.home(), "\n")
```

## 2. Validate Required Packages

```{r}
#| label: validate_required_packages


required_packages <- c(
  "TCGAbiolinks",          # query and download TCGA datasets from GDC
  "tidyverse",             # data manipulation and visualisation
  "SummarizedExperiment",  # container to store multi-assay data; AnnData of R
  "pheatmap",              # colorful heatmaps
  "DESeq2",                # differential expression analysis
  "edgeR",                 # differential expression analysis
  "apeglm",                # LFC shrinkage for DESeq2 visualization and GSEA ranking
  "clusterProfiler",       # gene set enrichment and pathway analysis
  "ggvenn",                # venn diagrams for visualising gene list overlaps
  "org.Hs.eg.db",          # human gene annotation database
  "enrichplot",            # visualisation of enrichment results
  "MCPcounter",            # cell type abundance estimation from bulk RNA-seq using marker gene expression
  "survival",              # survival analysis (Kaplan-Meier, Cox proportional hazards)
  "survminer",             # publication-ready survival curve visualisation
  "GSVA",                  # single-sample gene set enrichment scoring (per-sample pathway activity)
  "broom"                  # tidying Cox model outputs into clean, readable dataframes
)

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  cat(pkg, ":", as.character(packageVersion(pkg)), "\n")
}
cat("\nAll required packages present\n")
```

## 3. Create Project Folder Structure

```{r}
#| label: create_project_folder_structure


dirs <- c(
  # ========== data ==========
  # ----- raw data -----
  
  # raw sample TSV files from GDC
  "../01_data/01_raw/01_samples",
  
  # raw clinical metadata
  "../01_data/01_raw/02_clinical",
  
  # GBMdeconvoluteR marker gene reference datasets for MCPCounter (from Neftel et al. 2019/Moreno et al. 2022 papers)
  "../01_data/01_raw/03_deconvolution_references/01_neftel_neoplastic",  # Neftel neoplastic + Moreno immune (for primary deconv)
  "../01_data/01_raw/03_deconvolution_references/02_moreno_neoplastic",  # Moreno neoplastic + Moreno immune (for confirmatory deconv)
  
  
  
  # ----- processed data -----
  "../01_data/02_processed",  # intermediate processed data states
  
  
  
  
  
  
  # ========== figures ==========
  "../03_figures/03_qc",                              # before/after QC filtering plots
  "../03_figures/04_eda",                             # exploratory data analysis (EDA) plots
  "../03_figures/05_de_analysis",                     # volcano plot, DESeq2/EdgeR overlap venn diagram, DE heatmap
  "../03_figures/06_pathway_enrichment",              # pathway enrichment plots
  "../03_figures/07_deconvolution",                   # cell type composition plots
  "../03_figures/08_integration_and_interpretation",  # pathway-celltype correlation heatmap, KM plot, Cox model forest plot, Schoenfeld residuals plot
  
  
  
  # ========== results ==========
  "../04_results/05_de_analysis",                    # consensus and DESeq2/EdgeR results tables
  "../04_results/06_pathway_enrichment/01_ora",      # pathway enrichment (ORA) results tables
  "../04_results/06_pathway_enrichment/02_gsea",     # pathway enrichment (GSEA) results tables
  "../04_results/07_deconvolution",                  # cell type abundance score estimates
  "../04_results/08_integration_and_interpretation"  # Cox model object, Cox model results, KM plot results, Scoenfeld residuals, pathway-celltype correlations, etc.
)

for (d in dirs) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  cat("Created:", d, "\n")
}
```

## 4. Perform Sanity Checks

```{r}
#| label: perform_sanity_checks


created <- sapply(dirs, dir.exists)
cat("Folder creation check:\n")
for (i in seq_along(dirs)) {
  cat(ifelse(created[i], "✓", "✗"), dirs[i], "\n")
}

if (all(created)) {
  cat("\nAll folders created successfully\n")
} else {
  cat("\nWARNING: Some folders were not created\n")
}
```
